about: The voice trial of VILLAGE_PLAN V06 (D-game-22 (d)): one line, the same for every candidate of a sex, in every candidate voice and speed of kokoro-multi-lang-v1_0, for the owner to hear. The new NPCs' lines are recorded in the provisional voices (a voice with an npc here) when their files come (V10 to V12); a voice the owner rejects is changed in the NPC's file and its lines are rendered again. Rendered by the speech renderer: dotnet run --project tools/Vocaterra.SpeechRender -- --trial docs/game/voice-trial (through scripts/limited.sh). Each voice names its speaker id in the model's own list (model.onnx, speaker2id). The speech checklist lists a provisional voice until its NPC's file exists.

lines.female: Hola. Me llamo Luz. Tengo diez panes. ¿Cuántos quieres?
lines.male: Hola. Me llamo Mar. La panadería está a la izquierda de la torre.
